desc:
A chill cozy game about cleaning up after a tornado... 🌪️🌾

A twister tore through the farm and threw thousands of things everywhere. The family's away, the farmhouse is locked, and it's up to you to put everything back where it belongs.

👍 Like the game and join the group!

How to play:
🧺  Pick up the mess and put it where it belongs
💰  Earn cash for every item you tidy
⬆️  Upgrade your pockets, boots and more
🛒  Load up the wheelbarrow to haul more
🐶  Adopt Biscuit, your very good helper
💨  Use abilities like Gust to pull items right to you
📜  Find all the hidden Farmer's Notes
🏡  Tidy it ALL to open the farmhouse... and discover the farm's secret

🥚  Hatch golden eggs for pets that boost you
🏆  Beat your best time on the leaderboards
👨‍🌾  Play solo or with friends
